Why did tests/test_deepinfer_sync.py error at collection on Python 3.10 and 3.11 in CI?

The vendored deepinfer/__init__.py (DeepInfer pin 9bd9cf243fc53ef9afbf8f04d391d989117d6ab9) raises ImportError when Python is below 3.12. pytest.importorskip only treats ModuleNotFoundError as a skip, so the ImportError became a collection ERROR on 3.10/3.11.

What happened when scripts/hexstrike.py ran under python -I?

python -I hides the user site-packages, so PyYAML could not be imported. hexstrike fell back to JSON, all 1038 ledger/ YAML entries were unparsed, it reported 0 findings and exited 0. That is a ghost pass: it passed without reading anything.

What are hexstrike's exit codes?
0 clean, 1 ghost-seal findings, 2 usage/IO or an incomplete scan (some entry could not be parsed). Exit 2 takes precedence over exit 1.

What does scripts/ledger_iso8601_gate.py check?

Ledger entries added after base 778f4cf13e6a8ac2376e823b64eb84a59a245a4f must have a timestamp, and timestamp plus every *_at key must be ISO 8601 with an explicit offset, Z or +HH:MM/-HH:MM, for example 2026-10-30T13:02:24-04:00. Exit 0 pass, 1 a new entry violates, 2 usage/IO.

git diff --name-status --diff-filter=A <base>...HEAD -- ledger ledger.v2, plus staged additions and untracked files. The base is 778f4cf13e6a8ac2376e823b64eb84a59a245a4f unless --base or LEDGER_ISO8601_BASE overrides it.

In what order does /llm try its backends?

DeepInfer at 127.0.0.1:8090 first, then the DeepSeek tutor GGUF served by llama-server. In the serving setup the fallback is the deepseek-r2-1.5b GGUF on 127.0.0.1:8085. Both write to the same per-session history. This came in PR #155, merged as c9bff752b903d06052ad57880f849e2b57a71b2a.

How is /llm chat history kept safe across restarts?
sovereign-irc-bridge/src/llm_chat.py keeps history per session (?session=), appends with fsync, rewrites through a .tmp file plus os.replace, and holds a lock while writing. PR #155.

Why is the GGUF a release asset and not committed to git?
The GGUF is over 1 GB. In git history it would stay forever and removing it would need a force-push of main, so it ships as 25 MB release parts and is rebuilt locally.
